task.goal: What activities did I do October 05 2023 in the OpenTracks app? Answer with the activity type only. If there are multiple types, format your answer in a comma separated list.
task.final_summary: On October 5, 2023 you recorded two activities in OpenTracks: a snow boarding track ("Trying and failing to keep up with John", 4:00 PM) and a mountain biking track ("Skill work", 3:45 PM). So the activity types are snow boarding and mountain biking.

steps.note: Observe current screen to find OpenTracks app
Open OpenTracks and view activity list
Map full track list to see all rows
Open the two 5 Oct tracks and read their activity type
Scroll to Skill work row and open it
Open More options menu on Skill work detail
Open Edit form to read activity type of Skill work
Cancel edit, back to list, open 'Trying and failing to keep up with John' and read its activity type
Return to track list and open 'Trying and failing to keep up with John'
Confirm screen; navigate back to track list
Open 'Trying and failing to keep up with John' detail
More options then Edit to read activity type of second track
Read activity type in edit form of second track
